# Projects

This section contains selected research and publication projects managed through ResearchOS.

Project notes typically document:

- objective
- research question
- hypothesis
- research scope
- datasets
- methods
- experiments
- milestones
- current status
- next actions
- risks
- related literature
- related ideas
- planned outputs

Projects are developed in the private Obsidian workspace and appear here only when explicitly released for publication.
